task: write code for Jira ticket MPS-3 and store it under the right subdirectory

outcome.summary: Implemented MPS-3 (Mall Parking System fee calculation) under parking/. Added parking/app/pricing.py with FeeQuote, calculate_fee (grace period, rounded-up hourly billing, per-24h-block independent daily cap) and CheckoutService.quote (rejects unknown/CLOSED tickets); added STATUS_CLOSED to parking/app/ticket.py; extended parking/app/main.py CLI with quote action and fee flags (--grace-minutes, --hourly-rate-paise, --daily-cap-paise, --currency, --version); exported new API plus quote_ticket() from parking/__init__.py; added 27 tests in parking/tests/test_pricing.py. Verification: 68 pytest passed (was 41), 47 parking unittest OK (was 20), CLI smoke tests passed (success exit 0, TICKET_NOT_FOUND exit 1, invalid quote exit 2), import smoke test resolved all exports.

decisions.decision: Implement MPS-3 in the parking/ subdirectory (not mps/)
decisions.reason: jira/MPS-3.json declares project 'Mall Parking System', which lives in parking/ per MPS-2 conventions; mps/ is the unrelated Master Production Schedule ERP engine.
Confluence CONF-MPS-003 business rule states 'Every 24-hour block is independently capped'; e.g. 25h at INR 100/hr with INR 2000 cap bills one capped block + one hour = INR 1100.
A rate-without-cap configuration (default CLI value 0) should bill full hours; a failing test exposed that min(hours*rate, 0) forced zero.

decisions.decision: Extend the existing CLI with a backward-compatible quote action rather than leaving MPS-3 library-only
decisions.reason: Matches repo conventions (CLI is the primary interface for prior tickets) and keeps MPS-2 entry requests working unchanged.
MPS-3 requires rejecting CLOSED tickets; entry still only produces OPEN, and CLOSED is constructed directly in tests and will be consumed by MPS-4.

artifacts.purpose: MPS-3 pricing engine: FeeQuote dataclass, pure calculate_fee with grace/ceil/block-cap logic, CheckoutService with clock/ticket lookup injection, and TicketNotFoundError/TicketStateError
Added STATUS_CLOSED = 'CLOSED' constant for MPS-3 closed-ticket rejection and future MPS-4 use
Extended CLI: quote action in _parse_request, fee configuration flags, shared ParkingConfiguration for TicketService and CheckoutService, TICKET_NOT_FOUND/TICKET_CLOSED error results with exit code 1
Exports FeeQuote, CheckoutService, calculate_fee, STATUS_CLOSED, TicketNotFoundError, TicketStateError and adds default_checkout plus quote_ticket() convenience function

27 unit tests covering grace zero-cost, partial-hour rounding, daily caps (24h/25h/48h/no-cap), FeeQuote fields, negative elapsed, CheckoutService rejection of unknown/CLOSED tickets, and CLI quote behavior

failure_and_recovery.failure: ImportError: cannot import name 'STATUS_CLOSED' from 'parking.app.pricing' in test_pricing.py
failure_and_recovery.resolution: Changed test_pricing.py to import STATUS_CLOSED from parking.app.ticket (its defining module) instead of parking.app.pricing
failure_and_recovery.lesson: Import constants from the module that defines them; when a symbol is re-exported at package level, cross-module tests should still reference the original definition.

failure_and_recovery.failure: test_no_cap_charges_full_hourly_total failed (1 failed, 67 passed) because min(hours*rate, daily_cap_paise) returned 0 when daily_cap_paise was the default 0
failure_and_recovery.resolution: Changed _billable_paise in parking/app/pricing.py to apply the daily cap only when daily_cap_paise > 0, treating 0 as 'no cap'
failure_and_recovery.lesson: A zero-valued configuration default can silently zero out charges; handle sentinel defaults explicitly and add a regression test for the no-cap path.

verification.command: python -m parking.app with entry+quote batch, unknown quote, and missing ticket_id
observations: Entry+quote batch exits 0 and emits FeeQuote JSON with amount_paise/currency/pricing_version
Missing ticket_id exits 2 with stderr error
All MPS-3 exports resolve; quote_ticket returns FeeQuote with amount_paise 0, currency INR, pricing_version 1

reusable_knowledge: MPS-3 lives in parking/ (Mall Parking System module), not mps/ (unrelated Master Production Schedule ERP); parking conventions are parking/app/*.py, parking/tests/test_*.py, and `python -m parking.app` CLI with JSON stdin/file.
Daily cap semantics: each independent 24-hour block is capped separately; partial hours within a block round up; daily_cap_paise == 0 means no cap.
CLI exit-code contract for parking: success 0, single rejected quote/entry error (TICKET_NOT_FOUND/TICKET_CLOSED/LOT_FULL) 1, invalid request/JSON 2; batch results are emitted inline with exit 0.
Money is represented in paise (1 INR = 100 paise); ParkingConfiguration carries grace_period_minutes, hourly_rate_paise, daily_cap_paise, currency, version.

CheckoutService takes an injected get_ticket callable (wire TicketService.get for real deployments) and an injectable clock; quote() already rejects non-OPEN tickets, so MPS-4 PAID/CLOSED transitions can reuse it for exit-window recalculation.
STATUS_CLOSED is defined in parking/app/ticket.py and re-exported via parking/__init__.py and parking/app/pricing.py imports.
Use prior episode fdfc20c3 (MPS-2) as the convention template for Mall Parking System tickets in this repo.
